data.title: 圣路易斯 · 顶层酒廊的香槟私语
data.description: 俯瞰繁华都市夜景的云端高空酒廊，身着深蓝高开衩晚礼裙的圣路易斯轻倚吧台。她端起香槟杯与你轻轻相碰，清脆的声音掩盖不住她眼底浓烈温柔的爱意。
data.location: skyline luxury penthouse lounge at night
data.action: standing by floor-to-ceiling window overlooking city lights, clinking champagne flutes, alluring eye contact with mole under mouth prominent
data.lighting: glamorous amber chandelier glow blending with neon city panorama
data.mood: sophisticated high-society romance, captivating allure, quiet devotion
data.promptProse: Standing by a high penthouse window in an elegant blue gown, St. Louis clinks champagne glasses with partner with an alluring gaze.
